press_references.value: Gradiant Announces World’s First Fully Integrated Lithium Production Facility from Oilfield Produced Water

product_launches.description: alkaLi, a Gradiant spin-out, announced the launch of the world's first fully integrated lithium production facility using oilfield produced water, with commercial operations set for early 2026 in Pennsylvania.

press_references.value: US company unveils game-changing facility that could solve major challenge in electric vehicle production: 'Fully integrated'

product_launches.description: alkaLi, a US company, has unveiled a new facility in Pennsylvania that will be the world's first to extract, concentrate, and convert lithium from oilfield produced water in a fully integrated process. The facility is expected to begin commercial operations in early 2026 and aims to address major challenges in electric vehicle battery production by providing high-purity lithium with less energy, waste, and water usage.

overview_description.description:
Alkali is an independent insurance broker, outsourcing service provider, and consulting firm that leverages its innovative processes and unique team member abilities to educate businesses, employers, individuals, and families on insurance, so they are empowered to take personal responsibility for protecting the important things in their lives.

At Alkali, we strive to transform the insurance industry by creating innovative, strategically planned processes that empower, maximize value, and increase the integrity received by our clients.
